# VEDIXA ERP

> VEDIXA ERP is an enterprise resource planning software for fertilizer, seed, and pesticide businesses in India.

VEDIXA ERP provides fast GST billing, FIFO & batch-wise inventory tracking, customer ledgers, supplier ledgers, WhatsApp invoice sharing, and real-time business analytics.

## Public Links

- [Homepage](https://vedixaerp.com/): Official VEDIXA ERP main portal and product feature overview.
- [User Login](https://vedixaerp.com/login): Secure user login portal for registered business owners.
- [User Sign Up](https://vedixaerp.com/signup): Account creation and registration for new agri businesses.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://vedixaerp.com/legal/terms-and-conditions): Official terms of service and platform agreement.
- [Privacy Policy](https://vedixaerp.com/legal/privacy-policy): Platform privacy policy and data security standards.
- [Refund & Cancellation Policy](https://vedixaerp.com/legal/refund-cancellation-policy): Subscription refund, renewal, and cancellation guidelines.
